name: SimplyPrint
desc: 3D printer fleet management: monitor printers, manage the print queue, track filament, and automate print jobs.

actions.name: list_printers
actions.description: List every printer in your SimplyPrint account with current status.

actions.name: get_farm_overview
actions.description: One-shot fleet summary: total printer count plus per-bucket lists (online/offline, printing/paused, awaiting bed clear, in maintenance, requires-attention, AI failure detections, …). Use this instead of paginating "List Printers" when you just need counts and the printers in each state.

actions.name: get_printer
actions.description: Get detailed information about a specific printer.

actions.name: pause_print
actions.description: Pause the current print on a printer.

actions.name: resume_print
actions.description: Resume a paused print on a printer.

actions.name: cancel_print
actions.description: Cancel the current print on a printer. This is destructive — the job cannot be resumed.

actions.name: cancel_pending_print
actions.description: Cancel a print that's queued/staged on a printer but hasn't started yet (status = print_pending). Distinct from "Cancel Print", which targets the active print.

actions.name: clear_printer_bed
actions.description: Mark a printer's bed as cleared after a print finishes. Bread-and-butter step in AutoPrint flows — pair with a "print done" trigger to automate bed clearing.

actions.name: skip_print_objects
actions.description: Skip one or more individual model objects on the current print (printer must be in PRINTING / PAUSED / PAUSING / CANCELLING / RESUMING state). Single printer per call.

actions.name: set_printer_out_of_order
actions.description: Mark one or more printers as out-of-order (or clear that flag). Requires the Out-of-Order feature on the account.

actions.name: send_gcode
actions.description: Send raw G-code commands to an operational printer (requires Print Farm plan).

actions.name: start_print
actions.description: Start a print job on one or more printers from an existing file, queue item, or print-job reference.

actions.name: get_printer_notifications
actions.description: Fetch the open notifications/events on one or more printers. Pairs well with the `requires_attention` bucket from "Get Farm Overview".

actions.name: resolve_printer_notification
actions.description: Mark a printer notification as resolved (or dismissed). For notifications with multiple actions, pass `action` to pick one or `force: true` to resolve without choosing.

actions.name: list_queue
actions.description: List items in the print queue, optionally filtered to a single queue group.

actions.name: get_queue_item
actions.description: Fetch a single queue item by numeric ID — returns the formatted record (file metadata, assignments, custom fields, …).

actions.name: get_next_queue_items
actions.description: Resolve the next-up queue items for one or more printers using the company's match criteria (with deduplication so the same item is never assigned twice). Returns the matched queue object with item references per printer.

actions.name: get_next_queue_items_for_printers
actions.displayName: Preview Next Queue Items per Printer
actions.description: Read-only preview of the next-up queue item for each given printer (no dedup, no offline checks). For each printer, returns either the matched queue item or the issues blocking a match. Different from "Get Next Queue Items": that one dedupes for actual scheduling, this one shows what each printer would pick.

actions.name: list_queue_groups
actions.description: List every queue group on your account.

actions.name: save_queue_group
actions.description: Create or update a queue group. Pass an existing group ID to edit it; omit it to create a new one. Requires the Queue Groups feature on the account.

actions.name: delete_queue_group
actions.description: Delete a queue group. Items in the group are moved to "Move to" group, or to the first remaining group if not specified, or set to ungrouped if it was the last group.

actions.name: add_to_queue
actions.description: Add an existing file (API-uploaded or user-file) to the print queue. For uploading a new file at the same time, use "Upload File & Add to Queue".

actions.name: update_queue_item
actions.description: Update a queue item (amount, note, etc.).

actions.name: set_queue_item_printers
actions.description: Assign one or more queue items to specific printers, printer models, and/or printer groups. Replaces the current assignments on each item.

actions.name: move_queue_item
actions.description: Move a queue item to a different queue group.

actions.name: remove_from_queue
actions.description: Remove an item from the print queue. Destructive — the item is gone.

actions.name: revive_queue_item
actions.description: Bring a completed (done) queue item back to the active queue.

actions.name: empty_queue
actions.description: Delete every item from the print queue (optionally filtered to a group or done-only). Destructive.

actions.name: list_pending_queue_items
actions.description: List queue items awaiting approval, denied, or sent back for revision.

actions.name: approve_queue_item
actions.description: Approve one or more pending queue items.

actions.name: deny_queue_item
actions.description: Deny a pending queue item (remove or send back for revision).

actions.name: list_files
actions.description: List files in your SimplyPrint account, optionally within a folder and/or filtered by a search term.

actions.name: upload_file
actions.description: Upload a file or HTTPS URL to SimplyPrint. URL uploads stream with ~95 MiB peak RAM; File uploads are buffered by AP. Files over 95 MiB are chunked automatically. Returns the API file id — pass it to "Add File to Queue" or "Start Print" later.

actions.name: upload_and_queue
actions.description: Upload a local file or HTTPS URL to SimplyPrint and add it to the print queue in one step. URL uploads stream with ~95 MiB peak RAM; File uploads are buffered by AP. Files over 95 MiB are chunked automatically. For starting the print afterwards, chain a "Start Print" action.

actions.name: upload_to_folder
actions.description: Upload a file (or HTTPS URL) and save it to your SimplyPrint user file system, optionally inside a specific folder. URL uploads stream with ~95 MiB peak RAM; File uploads are buffered by AP. Files over 95 MiB are chunked automatically.

actions.name: move_file
actions.description: Move one or more user files to a different folder.

actions.name: create_folder
actions.description: Create a new folder in the user file system, or update an existing one (pass the folder ID to edit). Optionally an "organization" / shared folder with per-rank view/upload/modify permissions.

actions.name: delete_files
actions.description: Permanently delete one or more user files by UID. Returns a partial-success report — files the caller can't modify are reported in `errors` while accessible files are deleted.

actions.name: delete_folders
actions.description: Delete one or more folders (and everything in them). All-or-nothing: if any folder isn't modifiable by the caller, the whole call fails.

actions.name: update_file
actions.description: Rename a user file and / or update its compatible-printer assignments. (Thumbnail upload is not exposed here — multipart isn't supported on this endpoint over OAuth via the AP HTTP client.)

actions.name: download_file
actions.description: Download a file from SimplyPrint by user-file UID, queue-item ID, or print-job UID. Returns the file as an Activepieces file reference plus content-type / size metadata.

actions.name: list_filaments
actions.description: List filament spools in your SimplyPrint account, with optional filters and sort.

actions.name: get_filament
actions.description: Get detailed information about a specific filament spool by numeric ID or 4-character short ID (uid).

actions.name: create_filament
actions.description: Add a new filament spool to your inventory. Use the free-text brand/color fields for ad-hoc spools or the catalog ids for known SKUs.

actions.name: adjust_filament_weight
actions.description: Update the remaining filament on a spool. Provide ONE of "grams remaining" / "percent remaining" / "weighed gross" — the other two derive from it.

actions.name: mark_filament_dried
actions.description: Record that one or more spools were just dried. Updates each spool's last-dried timestamp.

actions.name: get_filament_history
actions.description: Paginated usage history for a specific spool — print jobs, weight adjustments, drying cycles, etc.

actions.name: assign_filament
actions.description: Assign a filament spool to a printer at a specific nozzle + extruder slot. Defaults to nozzle 0 / extruder 0 (single-nozzle single-extruder printers); set the indices for multi-nozzle (e.g. IDEX, toolchanger) or multi-material (MMS, MMU) printers.

actions.name: unassign_filament
actions.description: Detach a specific filament spool from whichever printer it is currently assigned to.

actions.name: list_print_history
actions.description: List completed print jobs, optionally filtered to a single printer.

actions.name: get_print_job
actions.description: Fetch a single print job's full record by its UID — timeline, pictures, spools used, gcode analysis, filament data, cost, AI inference, custom fields, etc.

actions.name: archive_print_jobs
actions.description: Archive one or more completed print jobs (removes them from the active history view).

actions.name: unarchive_print_jobs
actions.description: Restore one or more archived print jobs to the active history view.

actions.name: list_tags
actions.description: List all custom tags configured on your account.

actions.name: create_tag
actions.description: Create a new custom tag, or rename / re-style an existing one (pass the tag ID to edit).

actions.name: assign_tag
actions.description: Attach an existing custom tag to a printer, printer group, file, or queue item. Use "Create or Update Tag" first to get the tag ID.

actions.name: detach_tag
actions.description: Remove a single custom tag from one printer, printer group, file, or queue item.

actions.name: delete_tag
actions.description: Delete a custom tag from the account. The tag is removed from every printer/file/queue item it was attached to.

actions.name: get_current_user
actions.description: Return information about the SimplyPrint account connected to this flow.

actions.name: list_custom_fields
actions.description: List all custom field definitions on your account.

actions.name: set_custom_field_values
actions.description: Set custom field values on one or more entities (queue items, files, printers, etc.).

actions.name: get_statistics
actions.description: Fetch high-level printing statistics (total prints, materials used, hours, etc.).

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Call any SimplyPrint REST endpoint the piece does not wrap directly. Useful for admin / partner / school-dashboard endpoints and anything else behind OAuth scopes.

triggers.name: print_started
triggers.description: Fires when a print job starts on any printer.

triggers.name: print_paused
triggers.description: Fires when a print is paused (manually or by the AI failure watcher).

triggers.name: print_resumed
triggers.description: Fires when a paused print is resumed.

triggers.name: print_cancelled
triggers.description: Fires when a print is cancelled before finishing.

triggers.name: print_finished
triggers.description: Fires when a print completes successfully.

triggers.name: print_failed
triggers.description: Fires when a print terminates with a failure.

triggers.name: bed_cleared
triggers.description: Fires when a printer's bed is reported cleared (ready for the next job).

triggers.name: objects_skipped
triggers.description: Fires when one or more objects in a multi-object print are skipped.

triggers.name: printer_autoprint_state_changed
triggers.description: Fires when a printer's AutoPrint enabled/disabled state changes.

triggers.name: printer_nozzle_size_changed
triggers.description: Fires when a printer's active nozzle diameter is updated.

triggers.name: printer_material_changed
triggers.description: Fires when a printer's loaded material is updated.

triggers.name: printer_tag_assigned
triggers.description: Fires when a custom tag is attached to a printer.

triggers.name: printer_tag_detached
triggers.description: Fires when a custom tag is detached from a printer.

triggers.name: printer_out_of_order_state_changed
triggers.description: Fires when a printer is marked out of order (or back in service).

triggers.name: ai_state_changed
triggers.description: Fires when a printer's AI failure detection is enabled, disabled, or reconfigured.

triggers.name: ai_failure_detected
triggers.description: Fires when the AI failure detector flags a potential print failure.

triggers.name: ai_failure_false_positive
triggers.description: Fires when an AI failure alert is dismissed as a false positive.

triggers.name: printer_autoprint_max_cycles
triggers.description: Fires when a printer hits its configured AutoPrint cycle limit.

triggers.name: company_autoprint_state_changed
triggers.description: Fires when the account-wide AutoPrint master switch is toggled.

triggers.name: queue_item_added
triggers.description: Fires when a file is added to the print queue.

triggers.name: queue_item_deleted
triggers.description: Fires when a queue item is removed from the queue.

triggers.name: queue_emptied
triggers.description: Fires when a queue group (or the whole queue) is emptied.

triggers.name: queue_item_moved
triggers.description: Fires when a queue item is moved to another group or reordered.

triggers.name: queue_item_revived
triggers.description: Fires when a completed queue item is sent back into the active queue.

triggers.name: queue_item_pending_approval
triggers.description: Fires when a queue item is submitted and awaits approval.

triggers.name: queue_item_approved
triggers.description: Fires when a pending queue item is approved.

triggers.name: queue_item_denied
triggers.description: Fires when a pending queue item is denied.

triggers.name: filament_created
triggers.description: Fires when a filament spool is added to the account.

triggers.name: filament_updated
triggers.description: Fires when a filament spool's metadata is updated.

triggers.name: filament_deleted
triggers.description: Fires when a filament spool is deleted.

triggers.name: filament_assigned
triggers.description: Fires when a filament spool is assigned to a printer.

triggers.name: filament_unassigned
triggers.description: Fires when a filament spool is removed from a printer.

triggers.name: organization_user_signup
triggers.description: Fires when a new user signs up for the organization.

triggers.name: organization_user_pending
triggers.description: Fires when a new organization user is awaiting admin approval.

triggers.name: balance_charged
triggers.description: Fires when a user balance is charged (debited).

triggers.name: balance_refunded
triggers.description: Fires when a previous charge is refunded.

triggers.name: balance_topped_up
triggers.description: Fires when a user balance is topped up (credited).

triggers.name: balance_adjusted
triggers.description: Fires when a balance is adjusted by an administrator.

triggers.name: quota_request_new
triggers.description: Fires when a user submits a request for more quota.

triggers.name: quota_request_resolved
triggers.description: Fires when a quota request is approved or denied.

triggers.name: quota_adjusted
triggers.description: Fires when a user's quota is manually adjusted.

triggers.name: quota_reset
triggers.description: Fires when a quota period rolls over and a user's quota is reset.

triggers.name: maintenance_job_created
triggers.description: Fires when a maintenance job is created.

triggers.name: maintenance_job_started
triggers.description: Fires when work begins on a maintenance job.

triggers.name: maintenance_job_completed
triggers.description: Fires when a maintenance job is completed.

triggers.name: maintenance_job_cancelled
triggers.description: Fires when a maintenance job is cancelled before completion.

triggers.name: maintenance_job_overdue
triggers.description: Fires when a scheduled maintenance job passes its due date without being completed.

triggers.name: maintenance_job_reopened
triggers.description: Fires when a completed or cancelled maintenance job is reopened.

triggers.name: maintenance_job_updated
triggers.description: Fires when a maintenance job's metadata is edited.

triggers.name: maintenance_job_deleted
triggers.description: Fires when a maintenance job is deleted.

triggers.name: maintenance_problem_reported
triggers.description: Fires when a user reports a problem on a printer.

triggers.name: maintenance_problem_resolved
triggers.description: Fires when a reported problem is resolved.

triggers.name: maintenance_task_completed
triggers.description: Fires when an individual maintenance task is checked off.

triggers.name: maintenance_task_skipped
triggers.description: Fires when an individual maintenance task is skipped.

triggers.name: maintenance_schedule_created
triggers.description: Fires when a recurring maintenance schedule is created.

triggers.name: maintenance_schedule_updated
triggers.description: Fires when a recurring maintenance schedule is edited.

triggers.name: maintenance_schedule_deleted
triggers.description: Fires when a recurring maintenance schedule is deleted.

triggers.name: maintenance_spare_part_created
triggers.description: Fires when a spare part is added to inventory.

triggers.name: maintenance_spare_part_updated
triggers.description: Fires when a spare part's metadata is updated.

triggers.name: maintenance_spare_part_deleted
triggers.description: Fires when a spare part is removed from inventory.

triggers.name: maintenance_stock_adjusted
triggers.description: Fires when a spare part's stock count is adjusted.

triggers.name: maintenance_low_stock
triggers.description: Fires when a spare part's stock drops below its low-stock threshold.
